'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Clayton Atkin LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Clayton Atkin]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Clayton Atkin
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
